# Security-Sensitive Pause

Certain actions deserve explicit confirmation even when automation is tempting.

## High-impact categories

Credential exposure, cross-tenant data movement, public posting of internal content, and bypass of access controls.

## Minimize blast radius

Use least-privilege paths; narrow scopes; avoid spraying secrets into logs or chat.

## Recovery without widening exposure

Correct mistakes with targeted reversions rather than broadcasting compensating information.
